ticker_news.title: If I Could Only Buy and Hold a Single Stock in 2026, This Would Be It
ticker_news.description: The article argues that Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) is the single best stock to hold in 2026, positioning it as a neutral investment in the AI and tech buildout. TSMC dominates the contract chip manufacturing space with limited competition, benefits from continued AI infrastructure spending projected to reach $3-4 trillion annually, and maintains technological leadership with its latest 2nm chip nodes. Key risks include potential slowdown in AI spending and geopolitical tensions with China.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Up, S&P 500 And Nasdaq Slip As ADP Jobs Data Signals Modest Rebound— Mobileye, Penguin Solutions In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures were mixed on Wednesday following a strong Tuesday close. ADP reported private-sector job additions of 41,000 in December, signaling modest labor market stabilization. The Dow Jones futures rose 0.04% while S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures declined slightly. Key movers included Mobileye jumping 11% on a $900M robotics acquisition, Ventyx surging 68% on Eli Lilly acquisition talks, and AAR Corp rising 5% on better-than-expected earnings.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
